text: Salam. Grandfather here. My grandson, 6 years, has chickenpox, the spots are itching him a lot, wallah he can't stop scratching. Temperature tonight 38.6. Otherwise he is fine, eating, playing, al hamdulillah. I want a straight answer: what do I give him for the fever and the itching, and do I need to bring him in or not. Shukran.
